example_sentences.de: Bitte überweisen Sie den Betrag bis Freitag.
example_sentences.en: Please transfer the amount by Friday.

example_sentences.de: Der Betrag auf der Rechnung stimmt nicht.
example_sentences.en: The amount on the invoice is not correct.

cloze.en: I have already paid the amount.

words.notes: A sum of money on a bill or a transfer. Do not confuse it with 'der Beitrag' (membership fee, contribution) — one letter apart.
words.mnemonic: The verb 'betragen' means 'to amount to': Der Betrag beträgt 50 Euro.
words.germany_context: On German bills you constantly see Rechnungsbetrag (invoice total), Gesamtbetrag (grand total) and 'Betrag dankend erhalten' (paid, thank you).

example_sentences.de: Ich habe einen Gutschein für zwanzig Euro bekommen.
example_sentences.en: I got a voucher for twenty euros.

example_sentences.de: Der Gutschein gilt bis Ende des Jahres.
example_sentences.en: The voucher is valid until the end of the year.

cloze.de: Kann ich den ___ auch online benutzen?
cloze.en: Can I use the voucher online as well?

words.notes: The verb that goes with it is 'einlösen': einen Gutschein einlösen. A discount code in a web shop is 'der Gutscheincode'.
words.mnemonic: gut + Schein = a 'good note' you can spend like money.
words.germany_context: When a shop takes something back out of goodwill it usually offers a Gutschein rather than cash. By law a Gutschein stays valid for three years unless a longer date is printed on it.

example_sentences.de: Ich habe das Fahrrad gebraucht gekauft.
example_sentences.en: I bought the bike second-hand.

example_sentences.de: Gebrauchte Möbel sind viel günstiger.
example_sentences.en: Second-hand furniture is much cheaper.

cloze.de: Das Handy ist ___, aber wie neu.
cloze.en: The phone is second-hand, but like new.

words.notes: Past participle of 'brauchen' used as an adjective, so there is no comparative. A used car is 'der Gebrauchtwagen'.
words.mnemonic: Already 'gebraucht' — used up by somebody else first.
words.germany_context: The second-hand market here is huge and carries no stigma: Kleinanzeigen (formerly eBay Kleinanzeigen), Flohmärkte, and free 'zu verschenken' boxes left on the pavement. Furnishing a first flat this way saves hundreds of euros.

example_sentences.de: Ich schreibe schnell einen Einkaufszettel.
example_sentences.en: I'll quickly write a shopping list.

example_sentences.de: Der Einkaufszettel liegt zu Hause auf dem Tisch.
example_sentences.en: The shopping list is at home on the table.

cloze.en: Is milk on the shopping list too?

words.notes: 'Die Einkaufsliste' means exactly the same and is the word people use for the list in an app.
words.mnemonic: Einkauf + Zettel = a slip of paper for the shopping.

example_sentences.de: Leg die Schuhe einfach in den Warenkorb.
example_sentences.en: Just put the shoes in the shopping cart.

example_sentences.de: Mein Warenkorb ist noch leer.
example_sentences.en: My shopping cart is still empty.

cloze.de: Ich habe das Buch in den ___ gelegt.
cloze.en: I put the book in the shopping cart.

words.notes: Online shops only. The real basket you carry through a shop is 'der Einkaufskorb', the trolley is 'der Einkaufswagen'.
words.mnemonic: Ware + Korb = a basket of goods.
words.germany_context: On German shop sites the Warenkorb button sits top right; the checkout link is 'zur Kasse', and the final step is 'Kostenpflichtig bestellen' (order with obligation to pay).

example_sentences.de: Ab fünfzig Euro gibt es keine Versandkosten.
example_sentences.en: From fifty euros there are no shipping costs.

example_sentences.de: Wie hoch sind die Versandkosten nach Österreich?
example_sentences.en: How much are the shipping costs to Austria?

cloze.de: Der Pullover war günstig, aber die ___ waren teuer.
cloze.en: The pullover was cheap, but the shipping costs were expensive.

words.notes: Plural only — always 'die Versandkosten', never a singular. 'versandkostenfrei' on a product page means free shipping.
words.germany_context: Most German shops ship free above a threshold, usually 30-50 euros. Look for 'versandkostenfrei' and 'Kauf auf Rechnung' before you order — the second one lets you pay only after the parcel arrives.

example_sentences.de: Ich möchte meine Bestellung stornieren.
example_sentences.en: I would like to cancel my order.

example_sentences.de: Wir haben das Hotel gestern storniert.
example_sentences.en: We cancelled the hotel yesterday.

cloze.de: Kann ich den Termin noch kostenlos ___?
cloze.en: Can I still cancel the appointment free of charge?

words.notes: Verbs in -ieren never take 'ge-' in the Perfekt: hat storniert. Use it for orders, bookings and tickets; an appointment is usually 'absagen', a contract 'kündigen'.
words.mnemonic: The noun 'das Storno' is what booking sites and banks print on a cancelled item.
words.germany_context: German shops normally let you stop an order only before it ships. Once the parcel is on its way you no longer cancel, you use your 14-day Widerrufsrecht and send it back.

example_sentences.de: Der Bioladen um die Ecke hat sehr gutes Brot.
example_sentences.en: The organic shop around the corner has very good bread.

example_sentences.de: Im Bioladen ist alles etwas teurer.
example_sentences.en: Everything is a bit more expensive in the organic shop.

cloze.de: Milch und Eier kaufe ich lieber im ___ als im Supermarkt.
cloze.en: I prefer to buy milk and eggs at the organic shop rather than at the supermarket.

words.notes: 'Bio-' works as a prefix on almost anything: Biomilch, Biogemüse, Biofleisch, Bioladen.
words.mnemonic: Bio + Laden = the shop for Bio.
words.germany_context: Chains like Alnatura, denn's and Bio Company are in most cities, and normal supermarkets carry big organic ranges too. Only the green EU-Bio-Siegel on the pack is legally protected — words like 'natürlich' or 'aus der Region' mean nothing.

example_sentences.de: Ich möchte diesen Gutschein einlösen.
example_sentences.en: I would like to redeem this voucher.

example_sentences.de: Er löst den Pfandbon an der Kasse ein.
example_sentences.en: He redeems the deposit voucher at the till.

cloze.en: Have you already redeemed the voucher?

words.notes: Separable: Ich löse den Bon ein. Also used figuratively: 'ein Versprechen einlösen' = to keep a promise.
words.mnemonic: ein + lösen — you 'release' the value out of a voucher.
words.germany_context: The Pfandbon from the bottle machine is handed in at the till: say 'Bon einlösen, bitte'. You can take the money in cash or let it come off your shopping total.

example_sentences.de: An der Tankstelle ist Selbstbedienung.
example_sentences.en: At the petrol station it is self-service.

example_sentences.de: In deutschen Supermärkten ist Selbstbedienung ganz normal.
example_sentences.en: Self-service is completely normal in German supermarkets.

cloze.de: Am Buffet gilt ___, du nimmst dir einfach einen Teller.
cloze.en: At the buffet it is self-service, you just take a plate.

words.notes: Very often shortened to 'SB' on signs: SB-Kasse, SB-Waschanlage, SB-Bäckerei.
words.mnemonic: selbst + Bedienung = you are your own waiter.
words.germany_context: Nobody bags your groceries for you. The cashier scans very fast, so throw everything loose back into the trolley, pay, and repack calmly at the Packtisch behind the till — standing at the belt sorting your bags is the classic newcomer mistake.

example_sentences.de: Das Mindesthaltbarkeitsdatum steht auf dem Deckel.
example_sentences.en: The best-before date is on the lid.

example_sentences.de: Prüf mal das Mindesthaltbarkeitsdatum auf der Packung.
example_sentences.en: Have a look at the best-before date on the packet.

cloze.de: Die Milch ist noch gut, das ___ ist erst nächste Woche.
cloze.en: The milk is still fine, the best-before date is not until next week.

words.notes: Everyone says MHD. On packs it is printed as 'mindestens haltbar bis' — literally 'keeps at least until', not 'poison after'.
words.mnemonic: mindestens haltbar bis = at least keeps until.
words.germany_context: The MHD is a quality date, not a safety date: yoghurt, eggs, pasta and UHT milk are usually fine for days or weeks after it — smell and taste decide. Only raw meat and fish carry a real Verbrauchsdatum ('zu verbrauchen bis'), which you must respect. Supermarkets put yellow 30-50% stickers on food close to its MHD, mostly in the evening.

example_sentences.de: Beim Online-Kauf hast du ein Widerrufsrecht von vierzehn Tagen.
example_sentences.en: With an online purchase you have a fourteen-day right of withdrawal.

example_sentences.de: Das Widerrufsrecht gilt nicht für alle Waren.
example_sentences.en: The right of withdrawal does not apply to all goods.

cloze.de: Ich schicke die Schuhe zurück, ich nutze mein ___.
cloze.en: I am sending the shoes back, I am using my right of withdrawal.

words.notes: 'Der Widerruf' is the formal cancellation itself; in everyday speech people also say 'vom Kauf zurücktreten'.
words.mnemonic: wider + rufen — you 'call back' your order.
words.germany_context: By law you get 14 days to withdraw from anything bought online or by phone, with no reason given. The clock starts when the parcel arrives and a short e-mail is enough. It does not cover food, custom-made items or opened hygiene products — and it does not exist at all for things you bought in a physical shop.
